_doc: The Tailgate — a general pack (no cultural gate; see docs/PACK_PIPELINE.md). Authored 2026-08-27 against the vetted pool AFTER the anagram-twin fix gave HOARSE its slot back; HOARSE is the pack's prize board and the reason the fix mattered. Clue gate per theme-vocab _note: every clue names a position, a time, or a habit — never a category. No factual/citable claims on purpose: these clues observe, so nothing here needs a canon entry.

theme.name: The Tailgate
theme.blurb: Four hours before kickoff, a folding table in a parking lot, and somebody you have never met handing you a plate.

boards.scene: What is left of everybody's voice

clues.hoarse: How everybody sounds by Monday morning, and nobody regrets it
clues.share: What happens to a plate you swore was yours the second you look away
clues.sear: First thing that happens to anything that touches the grate, and the reason you wait
clues.hears: What the whole lot does at once when one radio finds the pregame call
clues.hero: Whoever remembered the extra propane, for exactly one afternoon
clues.ash: What the wind lifts off the coals and sets on somebody's white sleeve

boards.scene: The folding table, loaded past advice

clues.seat: What you lose the moment you get up to check the score

clues.paints: What she does to three faces out of the back of the SUV, one letter each

clues.snap: The one moment the whole lot goes quiet, even mid-bite
clues.pan: What the cornbread rode in on, and what goes home scraped clean

boards.scene: Cornhole, and the family that takes it seriously
